summary: Implementation plan for overhauling the Dream Garden Resort (Chapali Bhangal, Budhanilkantha) website into a visual-first, locally resonant experience grounded in its Facebook and Google Maps listings. Covers short bilingual Nepali/English titles, big photo cards, Facebook staycation and birthday packages, local favorite dishes (Mustang Momo, Sekuwa, Khana Set), and direct call/map workflows.
